target_customer: Ecommerce merchants and D2C brands, mainly Shopify stores in India, the Middle East and elsewhere
problem: Merchants sell and support customers over WhatsApp but have no shared inbox, automation or Shopify integration around it.
business_model: SaaS subscription by plan (about 50 to 500 USD per month per a third-party guide) plus paid AI agent add-ons

founders.name: Arjun Paul
founders.background_notes: YC launch post says the founders started an ecommerce business on WhatsApp, grew a following of 200K, then sold the tools as SaaS.

founders.name: Aromal Sivadasan
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder on the YC launch post and by YourStory.

competitors.name: WATI
competitors.what: WhatsApp Business API customer engagement tool, Hong Kong founded
competitors.traction_then: Series A led by Surge reported in July 2021
competitors.funding_then: Series A, with a later report of 8.3M USD led by Sequoia India in December 2021

competitors.name: Interakt
competitors.what: WhatsApp Business API platform for Indian SMBs from Jio Haptik
competitors.funding_then: Part of Jio Haptik, not disclosed

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly integration with the WhatsApp Business API and Shopify and building a shared inbox and automations; later AI agents add LLM work.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar vendors and dependence on Meta's API terms; Shopify integration and flows give limited lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors multiplied, with comparison pages naming SleekFlow, WATI, Respond.io, Interakt, AiSensy and Gallabox; no acquisition of Zoko found.

market_need_then: WhatsApp had a very large merchant messaging base, and founders reported selling on WhatsApp themselves; the YC page cites 175 million daily business messagers, a figure not independently sourced.

branding.domain_note: Uses zoko.io. A US trademark record for Zoko belongs to an unrelated owner.

identity.visual_style: design awards listed on the site (Red Dot 2023, German Design Award 2024, Good Design Award)
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident with short results oriented headlines; AI agents named Guru, Wismo and Sello.

branding.brand_signature: Named AI agents Guru, Wismo and Sello
branding.community_and_virality: 4.9 rating from about 450 Shopify App Store reviews per the site and 463 per a 2026 comparison guide.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct short name and recognized design awards, but no brand press or community beyond app store reviews.

outcome_analysis: Zoko raised a 1.4M USD seed in March 2021 from Y Combinator, Binny Bansal's family office and angels and has since grown into a Shopify focused WhatsApp platform with offices in Bengaluru and Georgia, ISO 27001 compliance and AI agents. No layoffs, acquisition or shutdown were found, but no later round was verified either, so growth stage remains uncertain in a crowded market.
notes: Seed confirmed by YourStory, Daily Excelsior and Devdiscourse. One report names 021 Capital and Weekend Fund as investors. Totals conflict: Caplight about 1.56M USD, CB Insights 2.53M USD over five rounds with placeholder details, Inc42 1.40M USD plus; none are recorded as extra rounds. Founding year varies by source (2018, 2020, 2021). Interakt is dated by Zoko's own comparison page and a profile calling it launched October 2021, so the date is approximate and after the batch. Company footer names Bourbon Science Inc and YourStory names Covocomm Software Private Limited. Founders' prior employers and education not found in any opened source.
